Elara Dawn — Album 4.5: Fides Fracta

Sound Of Defeat

"This is the sound of defeat"

[Intro - single held choral note, like a bell that won’t stop ringing] Victory has a silence. Defeat has a sound. And it is louder than anything I have ever known.

[Verse 1 - soft, reverent, each name its own weight] There was a woman who would break her bread in two Never asked if I was hungry, just already knew She tasted every sunrise like it might be her last gift I can still smell the warmth of it I cannot find the lift

There were children with small hands and questions about war Who told me I was sunlight when I walked through the door They braided red into the morning every time I knelt They called me — the Sun They called me — the Sun And I could not keep them warm

[Pre-Chorus - voice cracking, celestial hum beneath] I hear them still Not in silence — in the sound that fills the space they left A sound more absolute than anything That has ever measured loss or depth

[Chorus - soaring then falling, choir enters and breaks] This is the sound of defeat Not the drums, not the blade, not the burning This is the sound of defeat Every name I will never stop hearing Every laugh that will not come again Every door that will not open Every morning they were taken from This is what defeat sounds like when it enters you And doesn’t leave

[Verse 2 - intimate, almost too quiet to hear] There was a knight with careful eyes who never said a word But looked at me like maybe I was something to be heard I never told him that I saw it — there was never time He fell somewhere behind me And I never looked behind

And my horse — oh my horse She knew the way before I did She knew the weight of what I carried Every field, every ridge She trusted every order that I gave her Even the last Even the last

[Pre-Chorus 2] They marched because I asked them They held because I held And I am standing in what remains of all of that And something cold has come to dwell

[Chorus 2] This is the sound of defeat Not the drums, not the blade, not the burning This is the sound of defeat Every footstep that will not come marching Every voice that called me the Sun Gone into a ground I couldn’t harden How did I not see what was coming This is what defeat sounds like When it becomes the question you cannot answer

[Bridge - the blame arriving] I gave the order I chose the ground I read the field and I was wrong I chose the stand I should have fled I should have taken everyone along

Was it pride Was it certainty Was it the thing I told myself was strength That walked them into something I could not judge the length

[Final Chorus - changed, darker, the hymns fracturing] This is the sound of defeat And it will not stop And it will not stop And it will not stop

The Sun they called me The Sun I could not keep a single one of them warm This is the sound of defeat And her name is Elara

[Outro - a capella, celestial choir fading out] The sound of defeat Is your own name Called by the ones Who trusted you And are no longer here To call it
